physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the solar plexus, the soft basin behind the navel where the body keeps its weather. Not an organ exactly. A region. A nerve net laid through the gut and the diaphragm so dense it has been called a second brain, and it is the part of you that knows a room has turned before the mind has caught up. The seam between you and what is around you runs through here.

The shadow has its bodily floor in that basin. A tone lands wrong and the stomach tightens before a word has formed. The phone vibrates and the heat is already up. Reaction does not begin in the face. It begins lower, in the abdominal wall, in a quick clutch around the breath. People who live here long enough stop noticing they are clenched. They think this is what a body feels like.

The climb out is bodily and slow. Breath starts arriving lower again. The basin softens between waves instead of staying braced. A trigger comes and the heat still rises, but there is half a second now, then a second, where something can sit between the rising and the answering. That gap is not mental. It is muscular, and chemical, and the body has to learn it the way it learned to walk. The work of this card is teaching the gut to hold a charge without firing.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the region, this code answers to a single amino acid, Histidine. The body uses Histidine as the precursor to histamine, the molecule it releases when it needs to react fast, to flush a tissue, to flare an alarm, to open the cells to whatever is coming. It is the chemistry of the quick response. The body's built-in early warning.

There is a teaching in that, and it is exact. The code whose shadow is reaction runs on the very letter the body uses to fire its alarms. The trigger is not a mistake of character. It is a chemistry the body kept on purpose, because something in the lineage needed it to survive. The work was never to abolish the alarm. An alarm that cannot fire is a body in inert collapse, which is the repressive side of this same code.

The work is to keep the chemistry and change what it is used for. The same letter that flares the reaction also flares the awareness watching it. The code runs all the way to this: a reactivity built into the body's chemistry, kept, but slowly given a different job.
